facts.claim: Foreign couples spent an average of €67,000 per wedding in Italy in 2025, a rise of almost 9% on the previous year.
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland, How Much Does a Wedding in Italy Cost? (citing Centro Studi Turistici, Florence)
facts.use_note: Own page, published 2026-10-14, modified 2026-11-05. Attributed on the page to Florence's Centro Studi Turistici; primary study not opened in this FAST pass. EUR, no conversion. Nic sign-off.

facts.claim: The real wedding in Italy cost runs from about €20,000 to over €120,000, depending on region, season and guest count.
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland, How Much Does a Wedding in Italy Cost?
facts.use_note: Own page; framed as 2026 prices. EUR. Nic sign-off.

facts.claim: One Tuscan planner reports that a high-quality wedding generally lands between €800 and €1,200 per guest. On that basis, 50 guests sits around €40,000 to €60,000, and 100 guests around €80,000 to €120,000.
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland, How Much Does a Wedding in Italy Cost?
facts.use_note: Own page; planner unnamed. Per-guest figure supports a per-head comparison. EUR. Nic sign-off.

facts.claim: Earlier research from the same Florence institute found that food and beverage accounted for 35% of spend, the venue 21%, hospitality 17% and ancillary services 27%.
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland, How Much Does a Wedding in Italy Cost?
facts.use_note: Secondary report of Centro Studi Turistici; year of the earlier research not stated.

facts.claim: Many Lake Como weddings for 60 guests land between €80,000 and €150,000 before flights and guest rooms.
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland, How Much Does a Lake Como Wedding Cost? (Lake Como Wedding Cost: 2026-27 Budget Guide)
facts.use_note: Own page, published 2026-10-05, modified 2026-11-03. Body says three-day celebration; excludes flights, attire and guest accommodation; 'These are planning estimates, not quotes.' EUR. Nic sign-off.

facts.claim: Lake Como typical totals: Intimate, 20-30 guests, €30,000–€65,000; Classic, 60 guests, €80,000–€150,000; Grand, 100+ guests, €150,000–€300,000+.
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland, How Much Does a Lake Como Wedding Cost?
facts.use_note: Table on own page. Writer replaces range dashes with 'to' in copy. EUR. Nic sign-off.

facts.claim: A welcome aperitivo and a farewell lunch can add 25–40% on top of the wedding-day total. Italian VAT is 22% on most services, so check whether each quote includes it.
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland, How Much Does a Lake Como Wedding Cost?
facts.use_note: Hidden-cost angle. VAT rate from own page only; an Agenzia delle Entrate source would make it high confidence.

facts.claim: For a beautifully executed 100-guest wedding in Bali, Nicky recommends budgeting USD $38,000-$84,000, with luxury celebrations comfortably exceeding $112,000+ depending on venue, production, styling and guest experience.
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland, Bali Wedding Cost: The Complete 2026 Guide (Nicky Almeida, Nix Wedding Planner)
facts.use_note: SITE-CONFLICT-01 with F-09. Page states '(All figures in USD)'. Published 2026-08-03. Record both, no conversion; Nic decides which stands.

facts.claim: Budgets range from around AUD $5,000 for an intimate celebration to $50,000 or more for a luxury villa or resort event.
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland, Weddings in Bali (destination hub)
facts.use_note: SITE-CONFLICT-01 with F-08. Hub also lists 'Resort or chapel wedding: roughly $5,000 to $15,000+, depending on guest count' and 'Catering: roughly $50 to $90 per guest at resorts and villas'. Hub FAQ also claims 'Bali often costs less than a comparable wedding at home, even after flights' with no source; do not repeat that claim unsourced. No page date. Nic sign-off.

facts.claim: Peak season (June–August) drives up venue pricing, not vendor pricing. Couples willing to marry in shoulder season (November–March) can save 10–20% on venue costs.
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland, Bali Wedding Cost: The Complete 2026 Guide
facts.use_note: Planner opinion quoted on our page.

facts.claim: A Fiji wedding typically costs FJD $10,000 to $30,000 (about USD $4,500 to $13,500, or AUD $6,800 to $20,500 as stated in the source).
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland, Fiji Wedding Cost, Itemised From Resort Package to Paperwork
facts.use_note: Own page, published 2026-11-17. Lead with the FJD figure; the USD and AUD equivalents are the page's own, attributed by it to an underlying source, not our conversion. Nic sign-off.

facts.claim: A Maldives resort wedding for 20 guests typically costs between US$25,000 and US$60,000 all-in.
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland, Maldives Wedding Cost for 20 Guests, Itemised Line by Line
facts.use_note: Own page, published 2026-11-16. USD. Nic sign-off.

facts.claim: A Santorini wedding typically costs from €4,000 for an elopement to €55,000 or more, depending on guest count and style.
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland, Santorini Wedding Cost Breakdown for 2027, Line by Line
facts.use_note: Own page, published 2026-11-17, titled for 2027. EUR. Nic sign-off.

facts.claim: An Amalfi Coast wedding for 60 to 80 guests typically costs €60,000 to €110,000 or more, while luxury multi-day celebrations at landmark villas run €150,000 to €450,000 or more.
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland, Amalfi Coast Wedding Cost, Itemised for 60 to 80 Guests
facts.use_note: Own page, published 2026-11-17. EUR. Nic sign-off.

facts.claim: The average cost of a wedding in Thailand is around $10,000 USD.
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland, This Is How Much A Destination Wedding In Thailand Will Cost
facts.use_note: Legacy own page (published date 2025-01-01 in metadata, modified 2025-12-03), no underlying source named. Use only with Nic approval or replace with a fresh Thailand figure. USD.

facts.claim: The Knot puts all-inclusive venue packages in the US at US$10,000 to US$60,000, and DestinationWeddings.com reports an average of US$9,850 for an all-inclusive destination wedding, against US$36,000 for a traditional US wedding.
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland, All-Inclusive Wedding Packages: Real Costs Explained
facts.use_note: DO NOT USE AS A CITED FIGURE. Our page relays figures from The Knot and Zola (blocked) and DestinationWeddings.com (destination wedding agency, blocked). Recorded so the writer knows not to repeat them. US market only.

facts.claim: A US micro wedding of 20 to 50 guests usually costs about US$5,000 to US$12,000, according to our micro wedding cost breakdown. Resort packages in Mexico start at around US$1,500 for 10 guests.
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland, Destination Wedding vs Home Wedding Cost Compared (WW-335)
facts.use_note: Own page, published 2026-11-13. Wording assembled from the page meta description and extractor output; writer to confirm exact sentence on the page before quoting. US market, not Australian. Mexico is the only Americas figure found on our site. Nic sign-off.

facts.claim: Planners quote it in two main ways, a flat fee for a written scope or a percentage of your wedding budget, usually with a minimum fee underneath. Percentage fees commonly run at 10 to 15%, and some luxury planners charge 18 to 20%.
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland, Cost of a Wedding Planner vs Planning It Yourself
facts.use_note: Own page, published 2026-10-21. Same page also says 'For a wedding abroad, the total is the home planner, the local team, travel, fees per event and local tax.' Its AUD planner range comes from Airtasker (a marketplace) and is not reused here.

facts.claim: Wedded Wonderland recently conducted a survey with over 1000 past Brides to determine the average cost of an Australian Wedding. The Average (mean) cost of a Wedding in Australia is $67,307.37, and the Median Price (which is more reflective of what the average person spends) is $48,624.61.
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland, This is how much an average Wedding costs in Australia
facts.use_note: Our own survey, published 2017-02-15 (modified 2025-12-03). Not independent and about nine years old; it does NOT meet the authoritative home-average rule. Do not present as the current Australian average. Nic to decide if it may be cited as a historical, own-survey figure. AUD implied by page context.

facts.claim: Marriages and Divorces, Australia, 2025: 118,804 marriages were registered in 2025, 1.7% fewer than in 2024. The median age at marriage was 32.7 for males and 31.2 for females.
facts.source_name: Australian Bureau of Statistics, Marriages and Divorces, Australia, 2025
facts.use_note: Released 28/07/2026, reference period 2025. Supports the 'couples in their 30s' framing. Wording via Firecrawl extraction; writer to copy the exact ABS sentence at the claim. No cost data in ABS.

facts.claim: The most popular date to marry was 25/10/2025, with 2,035 marriages on that day.
facts.source_name: Australian Bureau of Statistics, Marriages and Divorces, Australia, 2025
facts.use_note: Optional colour on Australian peak season. Extracted, not read in full; verify wording before use.

facts.claim: Moneysmart's Marriage and money page gives no average wedding cost. It says: 'You can use our budget planner to help get a good overview of the money that will be coming in and going out.'
facts.source_name: ASIC Moneysmart, Marriage and money
facts.use_note: Old URL /getting-married redirects here. Last updated 18 June 2026. Confirms no government average wedding cost exists on Moneysmart. Link the budget planner (moneysmart.gov.au/budgeting/budget-planner) as an official tool.

facts.claim: Medical assistance is usually the highest unexpected cost for Australians overseas. Most countries won't give you free or subsidised care. You, or your insurer, must usually pay full price.
facts.source_name: Smartraveller (DFAT), Travel insurance
facts.use_note: Last updated 18/08/2026. Same page: 'The Australian Government can't pay your bills.' and 'We expect all Australians travelling overseas to take out appropriate insurance for their trip.' No dollar figure for medical costs on this page.

facts.claim: The average price for a comprehensive policy varies from $100 for travel in the Pacific to over $1700 for travel in Africa.
facts.source_name: Smartraveller, CHOICE travel insurance buying guide: How to save money on travel insurance
facts.use_note: Hosted on smartraveller.gov.au but authored by CHOICE (independent consumer body). Table: Europe $267 to $1335, Asia $112 to $1024, Pacific $78 to $307, Americas $495 to $1630 (cheapest and most expensive average policy per region), based on 230,296 quotes collected in March 2026. AUD implied. Note the page text says '$100 for the Pacific' while the table shows $78 cheapest; quote one or the other, not both. Per-traveller cost of risk, useful for the guest-cost section.

gaps.finding: None found. ASIC Moneysmart gives no average wedding cost (F-22). ABS publishes marriage counts and median age only, no costs (F-20). No government or independent national survey with an average Australian wedding cost was found. Commercial industry surveys exist (for example the annual Australian Wedding Industry Report produced by a wedding marketplace, and marketplace and competitor surveys), but they are blocked as sources, so no figure is recorded. Per the run-log default, the article should say no official average exists and compare cost categories (per guest, catering, venue, planner share, insurance) rather than totals.
